description: ATTOM sells U.S. property data covering more than 160 million properties, including property characteristics, ownership, deeds and mortgages, foreclosures, parcels with coordinates, neighbourhood and subdivision boundaries, schools, historical public records and building permits, with valuation, market and property risk analytics built on top. Delivery options are a property API, bulk licensing, cloud platforms and an MCP server, and the ATTOM Nexus platform lets organisations explore the data and check coverage before buying. Coverage: the United States. Access: by contact with a data expert and commercial licence. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: data aggregate county public records whose completeness and timeliness vary, and terms limit redistribution. Simulation uses are building-level exposure attributes, property values and permit histories for hazard loss and resilience studies. Related records: Regrid parcel data.
